subject: [PATCH v4 05/11] mm, swap: enable THP swapin for vswap entries

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch enables the swapping in of large anonymous memory pages (THP) for vswap entries when they share a contiguous run of physical swap slots on a synchronous IO device. This allows for more efficient swapping and reduces the number of faults that occur during the process. The patch also introduces checks to ensure that zswap-backed or mixed-backing batches are not swapped in as THPs, and that fault retries occur at smaller orders when necessary.
